CSE.notes: The current undergraduate programs index lists CSE at 130 credits. Earlier departmental materials exposed an older 134/136-credit interpretation; legacy waiver-based credit adjustments were removed so the repo matches the current 130-credit requirement.

CEE.notes: The undergraduate programs index lists BS in CEE at 149 credits. The department page was used as the current programme homepage.

ENV.source_title: BS in Environmental Science & Management | North South University
ENV.notes: The BS in Environmental Science & Management page lays out the 130-credit structure with 82 core credits, 15 concentration-core credits, 15 concentration-elective credits, 12 GED credits, and 6 open elective credits.

ENG.source_title: BA in English | North South University
ENG.notes: The BA in English page for 163 onwards students lays out the 123-credit structure with 54 university core credits, 39 school-core credits, 24 concentration credits, and 6 free-elective credits.

BBA.notes: The current BBA programme page states 130 credits with waiver-aware variants of 127 or 124 credits, which conflicts with the undergraduate programs index summary showing 120 credits. The programme page was treated as authoritative.
